summary: 🌊 **MyDirtyHoe** adds an experimental River tool with swimmable water, currents and waterfalls, and clears rocks and pebbles with Clear Forestry.
🔥 **FarLands** makes far bases' fires, torches and lamps glow at night.
⚡ **WeatherOverhaul** adds close lightning strikes, shared between players, and new weather settings.
🛠️ **SteadyFrame**, **ValheimVisuals** and **OdinBanners** get fixes for servers and compatibility.

bullets: Fires, torches and lamps of far bases now glow at night, as long as a fire has fuel.
Fixed a dark ring before the far view and shimmering far haze.
Sea mist is now off by default; turn it on with Air -> SeaMist.
Switches itself off on a dedicated server, so no more shader errors in the log.
Clear Forestry now also removes large shore rocks, broken rocks, ore rocks and small pebbles.
Terrain reset brings pebbles back where it touches a cleared area.
Experimental River piece: dig a river you can swim and sail on, saved with the world and shared in multiplayer.
Rivers have a current that carries boats and swimmers, running-water sound and animated water.
Fixed a "file is corrupted" error on start-up.
Experimental waterfalls: steep river stretches now pour over cliffs into a pool, with their own water, spray and sound.
Rivers blend into the sea, and the River piece no longer costs Stone.
Holding Alt with the hoe no longer sits you down, and placement labels are smaller.
Removed an incompatibility with Valheim Plus.
Fixed chunk loader zones being unloaded, which could leave joining players stuck on the loading screen.
Switches itself off on a dedicated server, avoiding "PatchAll failed" errors.
If a game update breaks one change, only that part stays off instead of the rest too.
Lightning can rarely strike close by, hitting roofs and treetops, and is shared between players.
New settings for each sky and weather, plus how many clear days have broken clouds.
The moon now hides the stars behind it.
Fixed sound stuttering when the game pauses to clean up memory.
Lightning now lights the ground and fog where it strikes, even far away.
Fixed bars of light across near bolts.
